title: The product frame (e₀, ιτ): orthonormal, spans an (m+1)-plane equal to π⁻¹(span τ)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_m) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P. Write Φ(s, u) := (s, u_1, …, u_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ u))), π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) ∈ ℝ^P (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{P+1} and τ̃ := (e₀, Φ(0, τ_1), …, Φ(0, τ_m)) : Fin (m+1) → ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => Φ(0, τ i))). Then (a) τ̃ is orthonormal; (b) finrank ℝ (span ℝ (range τ̃)) = m + 1; (c) as subsets of ℝ^{P+1}, span ℝ (range τ̃) = {z : π(z) ∈ span ℝ (range τ)}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (τ : Fin m → Eucl P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 : Eucl (P + 1)) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (τ i)))) : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1)) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (range (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 : Eucl (P + 1)) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (τ i)))) : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1)))) = m + 1 ∧ ((Submodule.span ℝ (range (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 : Eucl (P + 1)) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (τ i)))) : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1))) : Submodule ℝ (Eucl (P + 1))) : Set (Eucl (P + 1))) = {z : Eucl (P + 1) | ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ z))) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)}
